lens: Accessible interaction; first encounter (simulated expertise, not a human or Apple employee)
reason: The public proposition now states student-led, no-fee, semester-long consulting before the inquiry action. The supplied mobile capture coherently presents that offer and truthfully marks case studies pending approval. I traced the actual Home → Contact inquiry journey through native fields, shared trimmed validation, linked errors, post-unlock invalid-field focus, pending edit protection and bounded uncertain-delivery recovery. Focused synthetic keyboard tests support those improvements. The earlier deck shortcut collision is addressed by interactive-ancestor/event guards and explicit native result controls; the 35-check motion log supports tab-local motion-off, OS precedence and immediate reduced-motion application. Sign-out preserves navigation and restores retry focus; rubric validation now identifies name/key/weight errors. These are meaningful repairs, but the remaining consequential failure-feedback and save-recovery gaps prevent world-class agreement. Hosted and assistive-technology acceptance also remain absent. Hold is a recommendation to resolve and verify these interaction paths, not a claim of an observed production incident.

findings.evidence: Failed result application sets error and clears phase. The only error rendering is an ordinary footer paragraph at line 473; it has no alert/live semantics, focus transfer or association with the result button. The separate polite phase status at lines 331–333 reports applying/success but becomes empty on failure. deck-accessibility.spec.ts intercepts successful application and never asserts failed-result announcement.
findings.userImpact: A screen-reader operator can hear the pending result but receive no announced reason it failed; discovering the footer message requires manual exploration. This is a source-derived gap, not an observed AT failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose result/pointer failures through a persistent live error region or deliberate focused error summary, associate recovery guidance with the action, and verify a rejected application using keyboard and assistive technology.

findings.evidence: save() sets pending then awaits authorizedFetch without a signal or deadline; non-OK response.json is also unbounded. authorizedFetch in src/lib/client-fetch.ts delegates to fetch and only handles session refresh. Pending disables the whole fieldset and save action until finally. The supplied rubric test releases its deferred request with 409; it does not cover a nonsettling request/body.
findings.userImpact: A stalled save can leave an operator indefinitely unable to edit or retry, with unsaved scoring-guide changes held only on the page and no uncertainty/recovery guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the full request/body operation, preserve criteria, announce unknown save outcome and restore controls; reconcile the authoritative rubric before retrying an uncertain write. Add focused stalled-request/body recovery coverage.
